description: Servicio de visualización WMS de inventarios de desprendimientos de rocas con fragmentación is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.rockdb.upc.edu. WMS service for rockfall inventories with fragmentation data. Data from the source, blocks and deposit are displayed. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS View service of rockfall inventories with fragmentation" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.ca). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
